source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; IPNI; regional botanical treatment; USFS FEIS
synonyms_under_accepted_species: C. dactylon var. aridus J.R.Harlan & de Wet (heterotypic)
synonym_and_rank_caution: Historical C. dactylon var. intermedius and subsp. arcuatus map to accepted C. radiatus, while several other C. dactylon varieties map to C. dactylon. C. × magennisii is a separately accepted hybrid of C. dactylon and C. transvaalensis; common-name 'Bermuda' does not verify hybrid/cultivar identity.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no native/county fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — name verification does not certify the exact taxon of source photographs or sterile turf specimens
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — accepted hybrid parent formula does not establish ancestry of any particular specimen/cultivar
install_decision: Existing canonical C. dactylon only; no installation, no canonical edits, no separate taxa added

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon (L.) Pers.
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted species at rank species in Poaceae
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts C. dactylon (L.) Pers.; published Syn. Pl. 1:85 (1805). Existing canonical name and authorship match.

decisions.subject: Panicum dactylon L.
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain Linnaean basionym as a homotypic searchable synonym, not a new card
decisions.detail: Published Species Plantarum 1:58 (1753); POWO lists it as homotypic synonym of accepted C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Capriola dactylon (L.) Kuntze
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic historical genus combination to accepted C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO lists this 1891 combination among homotypic synonyms.

decisions.subject: Digitaria dactylon (L.) Scop.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic historical genus combination to accepted C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO lists the 1771 combination under homotypic synonyms; not a distinct Digitaria species card.

decisions.subject: Cynodon aristiglumis Caro & E.A.Sánchez
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to accepted C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO lists C. aristiglumis as a heterotypic synonym; regional Go Botany also records the synonym.

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon var. aridus J.R.Harlan & de Wet
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted C. dactylon species without maintaining a separate variety card
decisions.detail: POWO synonymizes the 1969 variety with C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon var. densus Hurcombe
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted C. dactylon species
decisions.detail: POWO synonymizes the 1947 variety with C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon var. glabratus (Steud.) Chiov.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted C. dactylon species
decisions.detail: POWO synonymizes the 1919 variety with C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Cynodon radiatus Roth
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species and its own synonym destinations
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts C. radiatus at species rank, distinct from C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon subsp. arcuatus (J.Presl) Kern & Henty
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies-rank name to accepted C. radiatus, not C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly places the 1969 subsp. arcuatus combination under C. radiatus.

decisions.subject: Cynodon dactylon var. intermedius (Rang. & Tadul.) C.E.C.Fisch.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety-rank name to accepted C. radiatus, not C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO explicitly places this 1934 variety under C. radiatus.

decisions.subject: Cynodon transvaalensis Burtt Davy
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species; do not treat as a synonym of C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts C. transvaalensis at species rank, published 1921.

decisions.subject: Cynodon × magennisii Hurcombe
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted named hybrid at hybrid rank; parent formula C. dactylon × C. transvaalensis
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts this 1947 named hybrid, with parentage explicitly stated; a distinct hybrid concept is not the ordinary C. dactylon species.

decisions.subject: Cynodon incompletus Nees
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve separately accepted species, not a synonym of C. dactylon
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts C. incompletus Nees (1832), with separate synonyms and taxonomic identity.

decisions.subject: Automatic synonym assignment of all names beginning Cynodon dactylon
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject prefix-only or genus-only synonym mapping
decisions.detail: C. dactylon var. intermedius and subsp. arcuatus map to accepted C. radiatus, whereas var. aridus, densus, and glabratus map to C. dactylon.

decisions.subject: Automatic collapse of named Cynodon × magennisii into C. dactylon
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject hybrid-to-parent species merger and unwarranted name aliasing
decisions.detail: POWO accepts C. × magennisii as a named hybrid and both parents as separate accepted species.

decisions.subject: Species determination of existing Cynodon dactylon gallery and source observations
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve specimen/photo identity holds; accepted binomial alone does not verify each photographed plant
decisions.detail: The canonical card already cautions that mowed, sterile turf may represent Cynodon species or horticultural hybrid. This taxonomy-only review did not inspect, change, or certify photographs.

decisions.subject: Cultivar, accession and individual hybrid ancestry of bermudagrass turf
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer C. × magennisii or a particular parentage from 'Bermuda' common name, fine leaves, or turf habit
decisions.detail: The accepted hybrid formula is a taxon-level statement, not evidence for individual source photographs, nursery lines or turf accessions.

decisions.subject: Unvouchered source-labelled bermudagrass turf material
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave specific cultivated-source concept unresolved pending source/propagation or diagnostic voucher evidence
decisions.detail: Current sources establish accepted taxa and hybrid boundaries but cannot determine which cultivated taxon each unvouchered, mowed specimen represents. No forced reassignment.
